D: A hotshot naval aviator competes at the elite fighter weapons school in San Diego.
P: Serve the snacks when Goose sits down at the piano in the bar.
S: Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter and honey, blue cheese dip
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter and a little honey, blue cheese dip and celery sticks.
Lager battered fish strips in tortillas with cabbage, tomato and lime sour cream
Flathead strips in a light beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime crema and pico de gallo.
Talk to me, Goose. Great Balls of Fire at the piano.

Smashed beef sliders with melted cheddar, sticky butter onions, pickles and a hot mustard mayo on soft milk rolls, served on a tray for the whole bar. Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter over low heat for 20 minutes. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp American mustard and a dash of hot sauce. Smash the balls thin on a smoking griddle, season, cook 90 seconds, flip and top with cheddar. Fill 12 toasted milk rolls with patties, onions, pickles and the mustard mayo.
M: Charlie's lemon chicken and Greek salad
Grilled lemon oregano chicken thighs with tomato, cucumber, olive and feta salad
Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, with a Greek salad and warm pita.
skirt steak in lime and cumin, seared hot, rice and black beans, for the Fightertown crew

Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin, seared over very high heat and sliced, with charred spring onions, Mexican rice, black beans and salsa roja. Marinate 800g skirt steak in the juice of 2 limes and an orange, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and salt for 2 hours. Cook 300g rice with 2 tbsp tomato paste and 600ml stock. Warm a drained tin of black beans with cumin. Sear the steak on very high heat 3 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thin against the grain. Char 2 bunches spring onions. Serve with salsa roja.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into rectangles and drizzled with chocolate
Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into rectangles, drizzled with a glossy dark chocolate glaze so they shine.
K: Frozen lemon slush and lager. "You can be my wingman anytime."

Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup frozen into a sharp slush, topped with ice-cold lager in frosted glasses for a frozen lemon beer float. Stir the juice of 4 lemons with 80ml sugar syrup and 200ml water and freeze in a shallow tray for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every hour into a slush. Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Spoon the lemon slush into the frosted glasses and top each with 250ml ice-cold lager.

dishes.make_ahead: Wings can dry overnight uncovered in the fridge

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and season. Bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once.
Melt the hot sauce with the butter and honey and toss the wings through it.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 1 day ahead and keep it on a tray covered in the fridge; make the blue cheese dip up to 2 days ahead. Bake and toss on the night.

steps.text: Cut the eggplants into thick fingers and season with the salt.
Coat each finger in the flour, then the beaten eggs, then the panko breadcrumbs.
Drizzle with the olive oil and bake on a lined tray at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Melt the hot sauce with the butter and honey and toss the eggplant through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream. Serve the eggplant with the dip and celery.

dishes.make_ahead: Slaw and salsa up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Whisk the flour with the lager into a batter. Mix the sour cream with lime juice.
Dice the tomato and onion and shred the cabbage.
Dip the fish in batter and fry in the oil at 180C for 3 minutes, in batches, until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with fish, cabbage, tomato, onion and the lime cream.

dishes.n: Charlie's lemon chicken and Greek salad
dishes.make_ahead: Chicken can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the juice of one lemon, the garlic and oregano.
Marinate in the fridge for an hour.
Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.
Toss the tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta for a Greek salad, with lemon juice.
Warm the pita and serve everything together.

veg.n: Charlie's lemon haloumi and Greek salad
veg.make_ahead: Haloumi can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Mix the haloumi with the oil, the juice of one lemon, the garlic and oregano.
Leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Grill the haloumi until charred on both sides.
Toss the tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta with the juice of the other lemon for a Greek salad.
Warm the pita and serve everything together.
Melt most of the chocolate with most of the butter. Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour and cocoa.
Pour into a lined tin and bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cool.
Melt the remaining chocolate with the last of the butter and drizzle over. Cut into rectangles.

Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes to frost.
Spoon the slush into the frosted glasses and top each with ice-cold lager.

s.note: Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter and honey, blue cheese dip
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter and 1 tbsp honey. Serve with 80g blue cheese mashed into 150g sour cream and celery sticks.

s.note: Lager battered fish strips in tortillas with cabbage, tomato and lime sour cream
s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with lime. Serve in 12 warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, diced tomato and onion.

m.n: Charlie's lemon chicken and Greek salad
m.note: Grilled lemon oregano chicken thighs with tomato, cucumber, olive and feta salad
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lemon, 3 garlic cloves and oregano for an hour and grill until charred. Toss tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and 150g feta for a Greek salad. Serve with 4 warm pita.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into rectangles and drizzled with chocolate
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cut into rectangles and drizzle with 80g chocolate melted with a knob of butter.
